/*
 * FROZEN EXCERPT — not a copy of the whole file.
 *
 * This is every line `tab-switch-latency.test.ts` actually extracts and
 * runs, verbatim, from the `TerminalPanel.tsx` this branch (sidepane4)
 * started from — before round 4's fixes. It is not meant to compile or be
 * imported; it exists only so the test's `rhsOf()` / `knownBlockOf()` slicers
 * have real "before" source text to extract from. See round4's two fixes in
 * the live file for what each block became:
 *
 *  - `focusWin` / `activeWindow`: two separate expressions over the same
 *    `tmuxWindows`, neither sharing a function — the stale-tab bug.
 *  - the `vouched`/`known` block: only `vouchedSeen` (live-agent memory) fed
 *    `known`, never the warm `identityOf` store — the visible-reload bug.
 *  - `lastFacts`: a per-tab shadow cache in `SidePaneFor`, written from
 *    whatever `at` this render happened to hold, whether or not it belonged
 *    to `p.tab` — deleted outright once the other two fixes make it moot.
 */

const focusWin = focusSess?.tmuxWindows?.find((w) => w.active)?.id ?? "";

const activeWindow = pendingWindow ?? tmuxWindows.find((w) => w.active)?.id ?? null;

const vouched = vouchedSeen(focusKey ? wtSeen.current.get(focusKey) : undefined, paneBook.current.get(focusPane)?.agent);
const known = vouched ? cands.find((r) => r.root === vouched.root) ?? null : null;
setDetectedWt(known);

const lastFacts = new Map<string, { at: GitRepoRef; pr: SidePaneFactsProps["pr"]; prRoot: string }>();
function SidePaneFor(p: SidePaneFactsProps) {
  if (p.at) lastFacts.set(p.tab, { at: p.at, pr: p.pr, prRoot: p.prRoot });
  const kept = p.at ? null : lastFacts.get(p.tab) ?? null;
  return <SidePaneWithFacts {...p} {...(kept ?? null)} />;
}
